notes: The *have* sits on the possessive לְ under rule 43: the clause is verbless, no הָיָה stands in it, and the preposition is what makes it possessive.
The suffix on לִי is unrepresented because the ASV elides the second clause's subject; the single *I* is written for אָנֹכִי and is not distributed across the two clauses.

*more … than* is one discontinuous rendering of the comparative מִן, headed on *than* per rule 24's degree-word sentence; *any* joins אִישׁ under rule 15's supplied-determiner sentence, which names the post-comparative slot.
